findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_post_length, write_thread_from_article · Public sink: split_thread, check_post_length, write_thread_from_article, count_post_length.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_post_length, write_thread_from_article · Public sink: split_thread, check_post_length, write_thread_from_article, count_post_length

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
